mem_result = await rlm.harness.create_memory(title='ARC: connect aligned color markers with 2', content='For this task family, the grid has a dominant background color and sparse foreground-color pixels/segments. Recolor background cells with 2 to bridge aligned gaps between nearby matching foreground segments, while preserving the original foreground. Demos confirm horizontal gaps between successive foreground runs and vertical gaps between aligned vertical components. Important: do not blindly connect every pixel in a shared row/column: segments that belong to horizontal bars may produce false vertical connectors; favor connectors between line-like components of the same orientation (as in the solved 10x19 case: fill horizontal gaps in rows 0, 3, 6, and vertical gaps in columns 4 and 18, preserving all 4 markers). A long gap between row-1/row-5 markers at c4 and c18 was not filled; distance/proximity and component structure matter. Earlier errors came from recoloring foreground cells and overconnecting all pixel-level alignments. Validate against examples and preserve marker cells.', global_=True)
print(mem_result)
